d:
375 karor rupae men bika Ranchi ka Nucleus Mall, koyla karobari L.B sinh sinh ke bete vivek ne kharida
Ranchi ke charchit Nucleus Mall ki 375 karor rupye men bikri ki khabar samne aaee hai. jankari ke mutabik, koyla karobari elbi sinh ke bete vivek sinh ke nam mol ki rajistri huee hai. aakhir Nucleus Mall ki is bari dil ke pichhe kya hai puri kahani? kaun hain vivek sinh aur jharkhand ke riyal estet karobar men is saude ke kya mayne hain?
